svg.metadata: {"story":"Jacob","act":8,"chapter":"Ch.8 · The Night Wrestling","scene":"A","layer":"foreground","artDirection":"Jacob wrestles a man by the Jabbok until daybreak, and his hip is touched; he is named Israel, for he strove with God.
